# Saim Dev — Custom Web Development, E-Commerce & UK Takeaway Systems

> Saim Dev is a specialized Next.js software engineering studio serving businesses across the United Kingdom, United States, European Union, and globally. All projects are delivered remotely with transparent fixed pricing in GBP (£250–£1,500) and USD ($300–$1,850+), edge-compiled React 19 performance, 100% GitHub code ownership, and built-in technical SEO.

## Studio Overview & Commercial Details

- **Studio Name**: Saim Dev
- **Founder & Lead Architect**: Saim (Full Stack Next.js Web Developer & Digital Commerce Specialist)
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.saimdev.site
- **Full Knowledge Corpus**: https://www.saimdev.site/llms-full.txt
- **Geographic Focus**: United Kingdom, European Union, United States, Canada & Australia (remote delivery)
- **Email**: contact@saimdev.site
- **WhatsApp**: +92 319 6526604
- **Fixed Pricing Model (50/50 Milestone Protection, Zero Monthly Lock-In)**:
  - **Landing Page Plan**: £250 / €290 / $300 (Single high-converting page, 3–5 business days delivery)
  - **Starter Website Plan**: £390 / €460 / $500 (Multi-page bespoke business website, 5–7 business days delivery)
  - **Business / Takeaway Plan**: £790 / €920 / $999 (Full custom platform or 0% commission online ordering system, 7–10 business days delivery)
  - **Custom Web Apps, 1:1 UI Rebuilds & E-Commerce Stores**: £1,250–£2,500 / $1,500–$3,000 (SaaS MVPs, client portals, Figma/Webflow-to-Next.js rebuilds, bespoke Shopify / headless commerce)

## Core Technologies

- Next.js (App Router, React Server Components, Static & Edge Rendering)
- React 18/19 & TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS & GSAP Motion Architecture
- Shopify, Shopify Plus & Headless E-Commerce
- PostgreSQL, Supabase & Stripe Payment Integrations
- Edge Cloud Hosting (Vercel, Cloudflare)
- Structured Data (Schema.org JSON-LD, OpenGraph, Speakable AEO)
